claim_boundary.permitted: candidate legacy TransferChecked flow and BuyEvent agreement, plus endpoint reconciliation state, only within the selected captured-block sample

development_freeze.bucket_time_rule: scheduled UTC bucket start must be strictly later than the freeze commit time

final_plan_gate.before_payload_open: After four selected frames seal, create a metadata-only selection manifest binding source/schema hashes, request accounting, signature/full-block reconciliation and each frame artifact hash; freeze a final plan that adds the exact audit-runner and test hashes. Open payloads only after this gate.

population_and_reporting.enumerate: all selected blocks, all transactions, and all PumpSwap v1 buy_exact_quote_in structural references
population_and_reporting.mismatches: retain and classify every discordance; any candidate-flow/event mismatch blocks a clean replication claim and does not permit predicate revision
population_and_reporting.primary_tail2_denominator: every successful frozen-predicate reference, including unknown_partial endpoint outcomes and any check failure
report_separately: each of five empirical fee-equation diagnostics
population_and_reporting.zero_eligible_rows: publish the captured-class census with zero rows; make no tail2 replication claim

selection.denominator: Report every scheduled bucket from 23:00Z through the fourth selected bucket, including gaps/failures, and separately report the four successfully captured frames.
selection.early_stop: If the unchanged c4 lease stops before four eligible frames complete, mark this audit incomplete; do not shrink the sample or create a replacement population.
selection.fallback: If a nominal eligible bucket is absent, failed, partial or ambiguous, record that scheduled bucket as missing/failed and continue only with the next naturally completed eligible c4 bucket. No manual tick, retry or backfill.
selection.rule: Select the earliest four naturally scheduled, successfully sealed c4 frames with bucket start strictly after the freeze commit time; use frame/STOP/request metadata only until the exact four are selected and source-bound.
